SHIVANI · A02 · 06:45–07:10 AM

A New Year Surprise Interrupted

Shivani × Rohan · Approved original Hinglish dialogue

APPROVED
<div class="a02-prose">
Narration — 06:45 AM
Main door khula. Rohan morning walk se wapas aaya, shoes utare aur kitchen se paani ka glass uthaya.
Bedroom ke andar Shivani dressing mirror ke saamne khadi thi. Burgundy saree pehen chuki thi, lekin pallu set karna aur baal banana abhi baaki tha.
Rohan: Madam lecturer! Happy New Year! Ghar mein koi hai ya sab vacation pe chale gaye?
Shivani: Kitchen mein paani hai. Aur haan, Happy New Year, Mr. Late Entry.
Rohan: Late? Main toh bilkul time pe aaya hoon.
Shivani: Tumhari ghadi ke hisaab se duniya chalti toh students ko kabhi attendance ki problem nahi hoti.
Rohan hanste hue bedroom ki taraf badha.
Rohan: Achha, aaj itni subah bedroom band kyun hai?
Shivani: Kyunki andar ek important preparation chal rahi hai.
Rohan: College ki?
Shivani: Nahi. Aaj ki preparation sirf tumhare liye hai.
Rohan darwaze ke paas ruk gaya.
Rohan: Oh! Toh mujhe invitation milega ya appointment book karni padegi?
Shivani: Appointment nahi. Bas thoda patience.
Rohan: Patience toh hai, lekin tum jab aise suspense banati ho na, expectations badh jaati hain.
Shivani: Phir expectations sambhal kar rakhna. Surprise kharab mat karna.
Darwaze ki halki opening se Rohan ko burgundy fabric ki ek jhalak mili.
Rohan: Ek minute... nayi saree?
Shivani: Tumne dekha kya?
Rohan: Bas colour. Waise burgundy tum par hamesha achha lagta hai.
Shivani mirror mein apni reflection dekhkar muskurayi.
Shivani: Sirf colour ki tareef? Poora surprise dekhoge toh kya kahoge?
Rohan: Woh toh dekhne ke baad hi decide karunga.
Shivani: Toh bahar jao. Aur aankhein band rakhna.
Rohan: Main apne hi ghar mein guest ban gaya?
Shivani: Special guest. Ab jao.
Rohan hansa aur living room mein chala gaya.
Narration — 07:03 AM
Shivani ne blouse ki sleeve theek ki, pallu shoulder par set kiya aur earrings uthaye.
Living room mein achanak Rohan ka phone baja.
Uski awaaz badal gayi.
Rohan: Hello... haan, boliye.
Kuch pal woh chupchaap sunta raha.
Rohan: Okay. Samajh gaya. Main nikal raha hoon.
Shivani ne dressing rok di.
Shivani: Rohan? Kya hua?
Rohan bedroom ke bahar aaya.
Rohan: Sorry, Shivani. Urgent work call hai. Mujhe abhi jaana padega.
Shivani: Abhi? New Year ki subah?
Rohan: I know. Mujhe bhi achha nahi lag raha.
Shivani ne haath mein pakda earring dressing table par rakh diya.
Shivani: Main tumhare liye kuch special plan kar rahi thi.
Rohan: Mujhe pata hai. Aur main sach mein dekhna chahta tha.
Shivani: Dekhna chahte the, lekin dekha toh nahi.
Rohan kuch seconds chup raha.
Rohan: Toh promise raha. Surprise pending hai, cancelled nahi.
Shivani ki halki muskurahat laut aayi.
Shivani: Theek hai. Lekin agali baar tumhari timing meri hogi.
Rohan: Deal.
Narration — 07:10 AM
Rohan apni zaroori cheezein lekar nikal gaya.
Darwaza band hua toh Shivani kuch pal wahin khadi rahi.
Phir mirror ke paas lautkar usne burgundy pallu dobara uthaya.
Shivani (dheere se): Pending hai... cancelled nahi.
Usne apni adhoori taiyaari ko dekha. Surprise ka waqt badal gaya tha, uska mann nahi.
SCENE COMPLETE — Approved.

SHIVANI · A03 · 07:12–07:45 AM

The Unsent Photograph

APPROVED
Narration — 07:12 AM
Rohan ke jaane ke baad bedroom mein ek ajeeb si khamoshi thi.
Shivani dressing table ke saamne khadi thi. Burgundy saree ka pallu abhi uske shoulder par loosely rakha tha. Ek earring pehen chuki thi, doosra dressing table par pada tha.
Usne mirror mein khud ko dekha.
Shivani (dheere se): Happy New Year, Mrs. Bad Timing.
Woh khud hi halki si hans padi.
Rohan ki baat yaad aayi.
Surprise pending hai, cancelled nahi.
Shivani ne doosra earring uthaya.
Shivani: Achha, Mr. Rohan. Dekhte hain.
Usne taiyaari poori karne ka faisla kiya.
Narration — The Burgundy Look
Burgundy saree ka fabric soft light mein wine-red aur deep maroon ke beech shade badal raha tha. Uski narrow woven border pallu ke kinare par subtle shine de rahi thi.
Matching blouse neatly tailored tha. Uski sleeves shoulders par smoothly baithi thi, neckline simple aur elegant thi, aur fitted waist se saree ka silhouette naturally defined ho raha tha.
Shivani ne pleats ko ek-ek karke straighten kiya. Pallu ko shoulder par arrange karke pin lagayi, phir mirror mein side se dekha ki drape symmetrical hai ya nahi.
Uske dark hair khule hue the. Usne unhe brush karke ek taraf settle kiya, jisse earrings clearly dikh rahi thi.
Makeup minimal tha: softly defined eyes, warm lipstick aur ek chhoti bindi.
Shivani (mirror se): Ab bolna, sirf colour achha hai.
Yeh sochkar uske chehre par muskurahat aa gayi.
Woh Rohan ko surprise dena chahti thi. Sirf nayi saree dikhane ke liye nahi, balki New Year ki subah ka ek personal moment banane ke liye.
Lekin moment adhura reh gaya tha.
Narration — 07:22 AM
Shivani ne dressing table se apna personal phone uthaya.
Camera open kiya.
Mirror ke saamne khade hokar usne pehle framing check ki. Background mein neatly made bed, curtain se aati soft winter light aur dressing table ka ek corner dikh raha tha.
Usne phone vertical rakha, thoda sa angle change kiya taaki saree ki pleats aur pallu dono frame mein aa sakein.
Ek haath mein phone tha. Doosre se usne pallu ki border halka sa straighten ki.
Uske shoulders relaxed the. Chin slightly raised, expression confident aur naturally warm.
Click.
Ek photograph.
Selected A03 mirror-selfie visualization
Shivani ne gallery mein picture open ki.
Usmein burgundy saree ki rich colour, neatly styled hair aur uski soft smile clearly captured thi. Pose elegant tha, jaise kisi special occasion ke liye privately ready hui ho.
Shivani: Not bad, Mrs. Lecturer.
Usne photograph dobara dekhi.
Phir Rohan ka naam phone mein open karne ke baare mein socha.
Shivani (soch mein): Abhi bhej doon?
Uski ungli ek pal ke liye ruki.
Rohan ne kaha tha ki surprise pending hai.
Shivani ne phone neeche kar diya.
Shivani: Nahi. Kuch surprises screen par nahi, saamne dekhne chahiye.
Usne photograph kisi ko send nahi ki.
Image sirf uske personal phone ki local gallery mein reh gayi—na message, na print, na cloud upload.
Narration — 07:38 AM
Shivani ne saree carefully utarkar fold ki aur wardrobe mein rakhi.
Usne apne college ke liye professional outfit pehna, dupatta properly arrange kiya aur bag mein academic notes check kiye.
Mirror mein ab ek different Shivani thi: composed, practical aur din ki responsibilities ke liye ready.
Lekin Rohan ka unfinished surprise uske mann mein tha.
Shivani (muskurakar): Pending, Mr. Rohan. Cancelled nahi.
Phone bag mein chala gaya.
Photograph gallery mein reh gayi.
SCENE COMPLETE — Approved.

SHIVANI · A05 · 08:16–08:20

A05 — Private Biology Lessons

PUBLISHED
Shivani apni scooty ke paas helmet nikaal rahi thi. Karan aur Aman saamne se aa rahe the.
Karan: Good morning, Shivani madam! New Year pe bhi college? Students toh bade lucky hain.
Shivani: Good morning! Tum dono ki padhai kaisi chal rahi hai?
Aman: Theek hai madam. Bas kuch subjects mein revision ki zaroorat hai.
Shivani: Achha? Kaunsa subject?
Karan: Biology, madam. Especially human biology.
Shivani: Really? Tumhara toh MBA chal raha tha, Karan!
Karan: MBA toh chal raha hai, lekin biology mein kuch topics aise hain jo theory se bilkul samajh nahi aate.
Shivani hans padi.
Shivani: Tum dono ko toh lagta hai biology ke lessons dobara padhane padenge.
Aman: Lessons ke saath practical sessions bhi hone chahiye, madam. Warna concepts clear kaise honge?
Shivani: Oh! Ab tum bhi shuru ho gaye?
Karan: Aur practical session kam se kam aadha ghanta, kabhi ek ghanta toh hona hi chahiye. Itni jaldi mein proper learning thodi hoti hai!
Shivani ne eyebrows raise kiye.
Shivani: Achha ji? Dono ne poora timetable bhi bana liya?
Aman: Timetable flexible hai, madam. Bas teacher experienced honi chahiye.
Karan: Toh private tuition available hai kya? One-to-one sessions bhi arrange ho sakte hain?
Shivani: Tum dono ko private tuition se pehle discipline ki zaroorat hai.
Aman: Discipline bhi seekh lenge, madam. Bas lessons interesting hone chahiye.
Shivani ne dono ko dekha. Unki shararat samajh aa chuki thi.
Shivani: Biology ke naam par tum dono ki chemistry kuch zyada hi active lag rahi hai.
Dono hans pade. Phir Shivani ne ghadi dekhi aur serious ho gayi.
Shivani: Achha, jokes apart. Agar genuinely revision chahiye toh topics bhej dena. Main apna schedule check karke sochungi.
Karan: Matlab private tuition ki possibility hai?
Shivani: Maine kaha na, soch ke batati hoon. Abhi koi promise nahi.
Aman: Okay madam. No pressure.
Shivani: Good. Ab mujhe college ke liye late mat karwana.
Karan: Happy New Year, Shivani madam!
Shivani: Happy New Year, dono ko!
Shivani ne helmet pehna. 08:20 par uski scooty college ki taraf nikal gayi.

SHIVANI · B02 · 09:00–10:30

B02 — The Biology of Attention

PUBLISHED DRAFT
09:00 AM — Shivani classroom mein enter hui. Harsh aur Laksh front row ke paas baithe the; Nandini notes aur Ritika board ka previous topic check kar rahi thi.
Shivani: Good morning, everyone. Happy New Year!
Class: Happy New Year, ma'am!
Harsh: Ma'am, New Year ke first day bhi class? Humne toh socha tha aaj relaxation milega.
Shivani: Harsh, tum relaxation ko bhi full-time career banana chahte ho?
Harsh: Ma'am, career toh serious hai. Bas aapki class miss karna afford nahi kar sakte.
Shivani: Interesting. Padhai ki wajah se?
Laksh: Ma'am, iska answer check kar lijiye. Yeh kabhi-kabhi question se zyada creative ho jaata hai.
Nandini: Ma'am, kal isi ne kaha tha New Year se serious student banega.
Ritika: Aaj practical demonstration mil raha hai ki resolution kitni jaldi fail hota hai.
Sab hans pade. Shivani ne board par HOMEOSTASIS — NEGATIVE FEEDBACK likha.
Shivani: Body apna temperature normal kaise maintain karti hai?
Nandini: Temperature badhne par sweating se cooling hoti hai.
Ritika: Temperature girne par shivering muscles se heat generate karne mein help karti hai.
Shivani: Excellent. Harsh, tum example do.
Harsh: Ma'am, kabhi-kabhi kisi special person ke saamne heartbeat badh jaati hai. Woh bhi biological reaction hai na?
Shivani: Heartbeat exercise, anxiety aur excitement—kai reasons se badh sakti hai. Sirf ek reaction se conclusion nahi nikalte.
Laksh: Matlab proper observation aur evidence chahiye.
Harsh: Toh theory ke saath practical sessions bhi hone chahiye.
Shivani: Practical mein observation, procedure aur result chahiye, Harsh. Sirf imagination se marks nahi milenge.
Ritika: Ma'am, iska imagination section toh already full marks le aaya.
Laksh: Bas actual answer likhne mein problem hai.

09:50 AM — Students ne heart rate aur temperature regulation ki case exercise solve ki. Laksh ne feedback response, Nandini ne recovery observations aur Ritika ne emotional arousal versus physical exertion ka difference explain kiya.
Shivani: Jab jokes ke saath actual concepts bhi revise karte ho, class productive hoti hai.
Harsh: Toh jokes allowed hain?
Shivani: Relevant hon toh.
Harsh: Reaction samajhne se pehle situation samajhna zaroori hai.
Laksh: Ma'am, isko bonus marks mat dena. Poore lecture mein isi moment ka wait kar raha tha.
10:25 AM — Shivani ne five revision questions likhe.
Ritika: Ma'am, next class mein application-based questions bhi karenge?
Shivani: Haan. Nandini, tum case study ready rakhna. Harsh aur Laksh, aaj ke five questions solve karna.
Harsh: Ma'am, thoda mercy?
Shivani: Class mein chemistry create karna aasaan hai, Harsh. Biology pass karna thodi mehnat maangta hai.
10:30 AM — Shivani notes lekar classroom se nikli; class apne assignments discuss karne lagi.

EP01 rehearsal familiarity retained. Harsh–Laksh adult undergraduate twins; Nandini and Ritika independent students, not faculty. Classroom scene remains a working draft accepted as the sequence advanced.

SHIVANI · B03 · 10:45–11:30

B03 — Four-Way Faculty Room Banter

APPROVED

10:45 AM — Faculty room mein Shivani ke saath Pooja, Kriti aur Dr. Aarav Sethi the. Aarav ke clever compliments se Pooja aur Kriti pehle se familiar the; aaj unki shared teasing ek step zyada mischievous ho gayi.
Part 1 — Pooja × Aarav
Aarav: Pooja, aap har baar mujhe dekhkar smile kyun karti hain? Kuch kehna hai toh privately bhi keh sakti hain.
Pooja: Private mein bulaoge toh sirf baatein karoge, Dr. Sethi?
Aarav hansa. Pooja apne jawab par blush kar gayi, lekin nazar nahi hatayi.
Part 2 — Kriti × Aarav
Kriti: Aarav, tumhe har conversation ko interesting banana zaroori lagta hai?
Aarav: Interesting company mile toh main time ka hisaab bhool jaata hoon.
Kriti: Phir stamina bhi achha hona chahiye. Har interesting conversation jaldi khatam nahi hoti.
Aarav: Kriti, mujhe lag raha hai tum mujhe deliberately challenge kar rahi ho.
Kriti: Challenge samajhna hai ya invitation, woh tumhari interpretation hai.
Pooja hans padi. Kriti ne coffee cup ke peeche apni smile chhupayi.
Part 3 — Shivani × Aarav
Aarav: Shivani, aap itni composed kaise rehti hain? Kabhi kisi ne aapko genuinely nervous kiya?
Shivani: Koshish bahuton ne ki hai.
Aarav: Toh mujhe bhi ek chance milega? Main challenges aadhe mein chhodne ka aadmi nahi hoon.
Shivani: Chance lene se pehle yaad rakhna, Aarav. Main expectations bhi high rakhti hoon aur evaluation bhi strict karti hoon.
Pooja aur Kriti ne ek doosre ko dekha. Ab chaaron ek hi playful exchange mein shamil the.
Part 4 — Common conversation; everyone joins
Kriti: Ek minute! Aarav, tum teenon ko individually impress karne ki koshish kar rahe ho?
Aarav: Main toh bas interesting company enjoy kar raha hoon.
Pooja: Achha? Teen confident women ek saath hon toh pressure handle kar loge?
Aarav: Pressure se problem nahi. Bas mujhe cheezein jaldi mein karna pasand nahi.
Kriti: Oho! Matlab patience bhi hai?
Shivani: Pooja, Kriti, tum dono iski interview panel ban gayi ho kya?
Pooja: Bilkul! Candidate ko experience, patience aur stamina—teenon prove karne padenge.
Aarav: Aur agar candidate saare rounds clear kar de?
Kriti: Toh final decision hum teenon milkar lenge.
Pooja ki hansi chhoot gayi. Kriti ne coffee cup uthaya.
Shivani: Tum logon ne toh faculty room ko interview room bana diya. Aarav, pehle written test pass kar lo. Practical ki permission baad mein milegi.
Aarav: Teen examiners? Yeh toh unfair advantage hai.
Pooja: Abhi toh humne difficult questions poochhe bhi nahi.
Aarav ek pal ke liye chup hua. Teenon women hans padi. Unke playful exchanges voluntary aur mutually understood the; koi actual private appointment ya invitation agree nahi hua.
Presentation coordination request
Kriti ke paas 1 PM ke presentation review ke liye connectivity request aa gayi.
Kriti: Achha, jokes over. Shivani, 1 PM ke presentation review mein phone connectivity check karni hogi.
Shivani: Okay. Main AV desk par phone lekar aa jaungi.
Conversation professional mode mein laut aayi.
Aarav's playful history here is lightly established staffroom familiarity, not an invented prior affair. Shivani's actual personal phone is handed over only around 13:00 in C01.

C03 — The Photograph on the Big Screen

PUBLISHED
13:06 PM — Conference room ki white projector light mein presentation slide ki jagah Shivani ki private burgundy-saree mirror photograph ekdum se aa gayi. Teeno men ne ek hi moment mein screen dekhi.

On the large HD screen Shivani stood in a bedroom mirror selfie. Her dark hair was wet and clinging to her shoulders and neck. She wore a deep maroon saree that had been styled like lingerie: a low, wet-looking blouse that barely covered her, the sheer fabric loosely wrapped around her hips and thighs, leaving her midriff and most of her torso exposed. The golden border of the saree caught the light against her glistening skin. One arm was raised behind her head while the other held the phone. A small bindi and long earrings were visible. Her expression was a confident, private half-smile as she looked at the screen of her phone. The warm bedroom lighting and the way the wet fabric clung to her body made every detail sharp and intimate on the projector.
<!-- SHIVANI_C03_GROK_GRAPHICAL_INSERT_END -->
Roz ki composed, traditional college lecturer aur uski private glamorous image ka contrast itna unexpected tha ki teeno ki baat ek saath ruk gayi.
Aarav stopped mid-sentence.

Lagbhag ek minute tak unke beech khamoshi thi. Aarav ki abhi-abhi hui faculty-room flirting ka echo, Dheeraj ki professional duty aur Malhotra ki silent curiosity—teen alag reactions ek hi screen se shuru hue.
Aarav (dheere se): Wait... yeh Shivani hain?
Dheeraj: Yeh presentation ka part nahi hai.
Malhotra: Nahi. Personal photograph lag rahi hai.
Aarav — Morning conversation ka echo
Aarav ko Shivani ka direct comeback yaad aaya: Attention earn karni padegi, Aarav.

Subah usne mujhe apni baat se roka tha. Ab uski private photo mere saamne hai. Maine yeh attention earn nahi ki; usne kabhi mujhe yeh dikhane ka faisla bhi nahi kiya. Phir bhi nazar kyun nahi hata paa raha?
Aarav ko Rohan ka khayal aaya. Shayad yeh photograph unke liye li gayi thi. Uski curiosity uske professional judgement se aage badh rahi thi.
Aarav: She looks... very different.
Dheeraj — Duty versus desire
Dheeraj ne projector controls ki taraf haath badhaya. Principal hone ke naate mujhe abhi screen band karwani chahiye. Shivani yahan hoti toh kya woh kisi ko yeh photo dekhne deti? Bilkul nahi.
Phir uski nazar ek baar dobara photograph par gayi. College mein hamesha formally dressed rehne wali Shivani ka yeh personal side... Uska haath ruk gaya.
Use pata tha ki sahi kaam kya tha. Phir bhi usne woh kaam turant nahi kiya.
Malhotra — Deliberate silence
Malhotra ne na compliment diya, na sawaal poochha. Pehle Aarav aur Dheeraj ke expressions dekhe, phir photograph par nazar jama di.
Ek personal photograph. Teen witnesses. Filhaal koi explanation nahi.
Uski khamoshi surprise nahi thi; woh jaanbujhkar apni curiosity aur intentions chhupa raha tha.
Shivani room mein present nahi hai. Photo ka appearance accidental hai aur teenon ke internal thoughts uski taraf se invitation ya consent nahi hain.

C04 — Three Separate Secrets

PUBLISHED
13:09 PM — Photograph abhi bhi screen par thi. Teenon ke paas use turant remove karwane ka mauka tha, lekin unhone alag-alag, conscious decisions liye.
Aarav
Aarav ne phone nikala. Usne kaha tha attention earn karni padegi. Yeh attention mujhe di nahi gayi. Phir bhi main us memory ko apne paas rakhna chahta hoon.
Usne image ki unauthorized copy capture kar li. Yeh faculty room ki flirtation ka consensual continuation nahi, ek privacy boundary crossing thi.
Dheeraj
Dheeraj ne projector aur room ke dusre occupants ko dekha. Principal hone ke naate mujhe photo protect karni chahiye thi.
Uski professional responsibility aur curiosity ke conflict ke bawajood usne bhi apne phone par photograph retain kar li.
Malhotra
Malhotra ne expression almost unchanged rakha. Bina kisi discussion ke usne separately copy rakh li; phir apne notes ki taraf dekhne laga.
Yeh unka personal moment hai. Isko dekhna bhi mere liye intended nahi tha.
Teeno ne apni copies ke baare mein kisi se kuch nahi kaha. Display wapas official slide par aa gaya.
Dheeraj: Let's continue with the review.
Aarav: Yes, sir.
Malhotra ne halka sa sir hilaya. Teen alag phones mein Shivani ki private photograph ki unauthorized copies thi.
All three copies are deliberate, independently retained privacy violations. Sunny has not copied the image. No public confrontation or additional physical incident occurs.
